long_biography.plain_text:
The sale of Maroone Automotive Group to AutoNation in 1997 turned a regional dealer into a national retail executive. Michael E. "Mike" Maroone had entered the business through the stores established by his father, then helped expand the company to nine franchises in six locations. The acquisition placed him inside a consolidator assembling hundreds of outlets across the United States.

Maroone ultimately directed retail operations covering 280 franchises and more than 20,000 employees. His remit extended beyond sales to service, marketing, e-commerce, property, technology and corporate development, giving him a central role in making a collection of dealerships operate as one network. After retiring from AutoNation, he returned to ownership in 2017 through acquisitions in Colorado and Florida. That platform re-established the family name in automotive retail while allowing Maroone to pass operating knowledge to a new generation.
